title: console/snapshot/v1
description: The snapshot frame, sent on connect and on every re-subscribe (decision record M29, Appendix C). Consumers replace their stores with it, they do not merge. Each item is a complete catalogued message with its own envelope, so every track keeps its own `ts`, `rx_ts`, `captured_at`, `time_source` and `backlog`.

alerts.description: `alert/v1` (USSP) and `violation/v1` (authority) messages. Their bodies are owned by the producing repos and checked against the mirrors once pinned; here only the envelope and the schema name are checked.

manned.description: `track/manned/v1` messages (ANSP-owned body, checked against its mirror once pinned).

zones_version.description: The CIS zones version the connection's zone data is at; null while the system holds no CIS version.
